Column Descriptions: Columns for the most part correspond 1:1 with page 34 of www.ensembl.org/info/docs/tools/vep/script/VEP_script_documentation.pdf
The chromosome in which the variant occurs
The position in which the variant occurs. Cooridnates map to REFERENCE_GENOME.
Reference Allele in REFERENCE_GENOME
Alternate Allele that occurs in place of the reference allele in the tumor sample
This is a CCG computed column. Indicates if the variant passes the filtering criteria used in the Variant_Summary_table tab
Look for PASS. These are variants that pass Mutect2's probability filters. For more info please see: https://github.com/broadinstitute/gatk/blob/master/docs/mutect/mutect.pdf
The effect for the given variant across the transcript.
The type of variant it is: SNV, Indel, etc.
The gene symbol or name
The database the gene symbol or name comes from. HGNC means the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee
The ID number for the Gene in the HGNC Database.
The ID number for the Gene in the Ensemble Database.
What kind of genomic feature? If there is mRNA that derives from DNA, will say 'transcript' in this column
The ID of RNA that derives from the DNA.
What kind of biological entity? The biological function of the RNA (i.e. whether it's protein_coding).
If the variant is in an exon, this will have the 'Exon number / Number of total exons'
If the variant is in an intron, this will have the 'Intron number / Number of total introns'
Relative position of the base pair from the start of the mature transcript (cDNA) sequence.
Relative position of the base pair from the start of the coding sequence for the original DNA.
Relative position of the amino acid from the start of the translated protein.
The amino acids that were changed by the genetic change.
The IDs in databases that catalogue known variations: COSMIC (start with COSV) and dbSNP (start with rs) Databases.
Allele Fraction from Mutect2. Mutect2 filters out normal tissue contamination reads.
Depth from Mutect2. Mutect2 filters out normal tissue contamination reads.
Frequency of existing variant in 1000 Genomes. This is a renamed column; it corresponds to the AF column in the CSQ section of the .vcf file.
Frequency of existing variant in gnomAD exomes combined population
Frequency of existing variant in gnomAD genomes combined population
Maximum observed allele frequency in 1000 Genomes, ESP and gnomAD
Populations (African/American, Ashkenazi Jewish, East Asian, South Asian, etc.) in which maximum allele frequency was observed.
